response.sql: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) as overall_average FROM station_avgs), filtered_stations AS (SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_avg, oa.overall_average, sa.station_avg - oa.overall_average as difference FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_average) SELECT observstation, station_avg, difference FROM filtered_stations ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
